definitions.explanation: The formal act of ascending to a throne, especially the Japanese imperial throne. Used primarily in historical and political contexts.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{天皇|てんのう}が{即位|そくい}した。
examples.english: The new Emperor ascended the throne.

examples.japanese: {即位|そくい}の{礼|れい}が{行|おこな}われた。
{国王|こくおう}の{即位|そくい}を{祝|いわ}うパレードが{街|まち}を{練|ね}り{歩|ある}いた。
examples.english: A parade celebrating the king's enthronement marched through the city.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{即位|そくい}する (ascend the throne)
・{即位|そくい}の{礼|れい} (enthronement ceremony)
・{即位|そくい}{式|しき} (coronation ceremony)
・{即位|そくい}を{祝|いわ}う (celebrate the enthronement)

USAGE NOTES:
In Japanese context, {即位|そくい} refers specifically to the Emperor's accession. The formal ceremony is called {即位|そくい}の{礼|れい} ({即位礼正殿|そくいれいせいでん}の{儀|ぎ} in its full form). The most recent enthronement was in 2019 when Emperor Naruhito ascended to the Chrysanthemum Throne. The word can also be used for foreign monarchs.
